projects.title: AI-Medical Assistant: Clinical Diagnosis & Triage Platform
projects.description: An AI-based clinical decision-support platform featuring conversational symptom checking with emergency red-flag triage, hybrid ML (Scikit-learn + Groq LLaMA fallback), MongoDB care context, and printable medical PDF summaries.
projects.fullDescription: Next-generation clinical decision-support system featuring multi-turn conversational symptom checking with real-time rule-based emergency triage. Powered by a hybrid prediction engine combining Python Scikit-learn models (RandomForest/XGBoost) with Groq LLaMA models and Gemini API for zero-downtime inference fallback. Cross-references MongoDB collections for dataset care insights, JWT session authentication, AI diet planning, and printable medical PDF summary exports.
